title: Fix container-gates regressions in assembly render and fab composite views
body:
## Summary

Fixes the two `container-gates` regressions that left main CI red after the B1/B2 merges, without relaxing any crosscheck thresholds:

1. **`assembly_render._resolve_within_base`** — manifest paths like `out/gd1-enclosure/3d/assembly.glb` are CWD-relative, but the renderer joined them onto the output root (`out/gd1-enclosure/out/gd1-enclosure/...`) and failed the GLB lookup, aborting the GD1 enclosure lane at `[3/5]`. Now resolves `Path.resolve()` against CWD first and keeps the fail-closed containment check (`relative_to(root)` still raises `ExternalToolError` on escape), matching the `_common.py` convention used elsewhere.

2. **`composite_view.wrap_fab_svg`** — emitted canonical `width`/`height` attributes via `format_svg_number` but copied the raw gerbonara `viewBox` and `data-raw-*` attributes verbatim, so the `svg-units`/`svg-fab-viewbox` exact-equality checks flagged a self-inconsistency whenever gerbonara emitted float-repr numbers (e.g. `38.099999999999994` on the 38.1 mm mini-blink-dongle board). A new `_canonical_raw_geometry` helper normalizes all nested-view dimensions through `format_svg_number`, so exact-equality checks still apply.

Verified end-to-end inside the locked server image (`ghcr.io/vibebb/acd-server@sha256:0b91ef…`): MBD lanes `[1/4]`–`[4/4]` all PASS with `visual-crosscheck-fab.json` status `match`, and the GD1 enclosure lane completes with `visual-crosscheck-assembly-render.json` status `match` (4 view SVGs).

Regression tests added:
- `test_generate_and_crosscheck_with_cwd_relative_paths` — generate + crosscheck under `monkeypatch.chdir`, asserting no `out/out` double-nesting and `report.status == "match"`.
- `test_wrap_fab_svg_emits_canonical_numbers_for_float_noise` — raw SVG with float-repr dimensions asserts `data-raw-*`/`viewBox` canonicalization; `test_wrap_fab_svg_still_rejects_missing_millimeter_units` keeps the fail-closed rejection.
